certificate.method: regular Newton fan and exact torus Jacobian tests
certificate.description: A sequence of triangular polynomial substitutions, each fixing the origin with Jacobian determinant one, gives coordinates in which the exceptional images lie in the singular locus and the faces over the origin are nondegenerate. The map is an isomorphism off the origin. All compact faces are nondegenerate and every maximal cone has lattice determinant one. The strict transform is smooth and transverse to the toric strata in a neighborhood of the fiber over the origin.
certificate.atlas_verification: Strict transform on the owned origin fibre
